# Jason Yau

> Jason Yau is a senior software engineer and consultant. This index points to public pages about his work and consulting services.

## Main site

- [Jason Yau — portfolio and contact](https://jason.yfyau.com/): Career background, interests, consulting overview, and contact links.

## Consulting services

- [Practical AI Transformation](https://jason.yfyau.com/services/ai-transformation/): Find useful AI and workflow automation opportunities, improve the process, and build practical tools.
- [From Prototype to Product](https://jason.yfyau.com/services/prototype-to-product/): Review and improve prototypes or existing systems for reliability and maintainability.
- [Custom Digital Products](https://jason.yfyau.com/services/custom-digital-products/): Define, design, build, and launch tailored web or mobile products around user needs.
